_comment: Deal 1 arcane to target opposing hero; the next card you play this turn with an arcane-damage effect instead deals that much +X, where X = the damage this dealt (1). Modeled as DEAL_ARCANE 1 + AMP 1 (Amp = engine's 'next arcane damage this turn +N', CR 8.5.47). X is 1 in the base case (the 1 arcane it deals); the dynamic 'X = damage actually dealt' is simplified to the printed 1. Prior JSON used SET_FLAG + a STATIC MODIFY_ATTACK on a non-existent DEAL_ARCANE keyword (buffs attack power, not arcane).
